summary: Cresco Labs filed a Form 6-K furnishing a supplement dated October 9, 2026 to its September 18, 2026 management information circular for the annual general and special meeting on October 30, 2026. The supplement clarifies voting-rights breakdown as of the record date (roughly 26% subordinate, 1% proportionate, 73% multiple, 0.0001% special subordinate voting shares) and specifies that MI 61-101 minority approval for the proposed multiple-voting-share amendment will be taken by separate class votes, excluding 5,817 proportionate and 5,344,321 subordinate shares held by Messrs. Bachtell, Sampson, Manning, the Brian McCormack Trust and affiliates. No proxies are being redistributed; advisory firm Laurel Hill is named. This is routine meeting/clarification material, not a special situation.
